description.en: The end time of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
The ID of the API group.

description.zh:
指定要查询的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
The environment in which you want to perform the query. Valid values:

- **RELEASE**: the production environment

- **PRE**: the staging environment

- **TEST**: the test environment

description.zh: 开始时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
description.en: The start time of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
